references.text: Moses receives instructions to make the ark of acacia wood, which he now carries out in Deuteronomy 10:3
Moses is told to carve two new stone tablets like the first ones, referred to here as 'like the first ones'
Bezalel makes the ark of acacia wood according to the instructions, parallel to Moses' action here
The first tablets were broken by Moses, which made the new tablets mentioned here necessary
God's command to Moses to make the ark and new stone tablets, which Moses now carries out
Confirms that only the two stone tablets were in the ark, the same tablets Moses made here
The Epistle to the Hebrews refers to the ark of the covenant containing the tablets of the law
